name: Number Systems Diagram
description: Shows the nesting of number systems with clickable drill-down to sections in the Markdown page.
learningObjectives: Identify the nested relationship among natural numbers, integers, rational numbers, and real numbers in the diagram
Classify a given number such as -3, 2/5, or the square root of 2 into the smallest number system that contains it
Explain why every integer is a rational number but not every rational number is an integer
Locate the definition of each number system by clicking its node to jump to the matching page section
